entwurf - native harness entrypoints and garden facts

Usage:
  entwurf <command> [args...]
  entwurf help [<command>]            this overview, or one command's full description
  entwurf help all                    all documented commands, developer gates included
  entwurf -h                          this overview (--help works too)

Launch native runtimes:
  entwurf pi [args...]                pi with Entwurf control; args go to pi
  entwurf pi-durable [args...]        the packaged durable pi launcher
  entwurf copilot [args...]           Copilot with its Entwurf extension enabled
  entwurf codex-app-server [args...]  Codex's app-server on the socket Entwurf reads

Set up and check this host:
  entwurf setup [project-dir]         wire detected harnesses; report PASS/SKIP/FAIL each
  entwurf doctor-meta-bridge          check the Claude Code wiring
  entwurf doctor-pi-package           inspect ownership of the global pi registration

Look at the garden (read-only JSON):
  entwurf peer-facts                  siblings and their live-rail facts
  entwurf meta-facts                  garden records and store diagnostics

Remove wiring:
  entwurf remove [project-dir]        remove this project's pi registration
  entwurf remove-user-scope           remove the global pi registration
  entwurf uninstall-meta-bridge       restore what the Claude Code install recorded

Herdr plugin (from its active runtime):
  entwurf herdr-plugin-expose-operator --bin-dir <abs>  create the one operator link
  entwurf herdr-plugin-withdraw-operator                remove the owned link
  entwurf herdr-plugin-deactivate                       undo plugin wiring and runtime

Examples:
  # Start pi in the current project
  entwurf pi

  # Read a command before changing this host
  entwurf help setup

  # See who is in the garden
  entwurf peer-facts

Fresh call, send, resume and retire are entwurf-bridge MCP tools inside a session,
not commands here. Advanced maintenance and development gates: entwurf help all
